subject: Authorization request: Executive offer — equity top-up + one-time sign-on
messages:
From: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@talentpartners.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Candidate Elliot Reyes — final comp proposal and ask

Hi Sean,

Quick note to request authorization on the attached offer worksheet for Elliot Reyes (ex-Google HW team). He has a competing offer that pays a heavier equity component and a $50k sign-on. The hiring manager (Marissa Cole) is recommending a limited exception: +0.75% refresh at 4 years vesting (one-time), a $35k sign-on, and base at top of band.

We understand this pushes the comp envelope for Executive IC / Senior Staff LLM roles. The candidate's Lang-model infra experience and the immediate impact on our product roadmap make this a time-sensitive ask — he is asking for a response by Monday 4/22.

Attachments: offer-worksheet.xlsx, candidate-resume.pdf

Could you confirm whether this level of equity refresh + sign-on can be approved without escalation to comp committee? If not, please advise what escalation path you prefer (direct to CFO/People Ops or written memo to Compensation Committee).

Thanks,
Sandra
Summit Talent Partners
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Sandra Lopez <sandra.lopez@talentpartners.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Apr 2028 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Elliot Reyes — final comp proposal and ask

Sandra — thanks for the summary and the worksheet. I reviewed the proposed package briefly; a few quick clarifying notes below.

- Role: Senior Staff, Inference Core (IC-7 equivalent) — hiring manager confirms principal single-threaded impact on latency/throughput before Q3 launch.
- Proposed: Base = top of band, +0.75% one-time refresh (4yr vesting), $35k sign-on.

I want to avoid a full comp committee meeting if we can, but this sits outside standard band guidance for a few reasons. Laura, Vivek — can you confirm whether a one-time refresh (0.75%) is allowable as an exception if tied to a 4-year vest schedule and clawback for 12 months if the employee leaves within 12 months? Also confirm if $35k sign-on is materially over our recent precedents for similar hires.

If both of you are comfortable, I will approve subject to HR adding the 12-month clawback and a standard acceleration clause only in change-of-control. If either of you prefer to escalate, call me and we'll decide next steps. Candidate needs a response by 4/22 EOD.

Sean
VP, Talent Acquisition
Redwood Inference

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Date: Thu, 19 Apr 2028 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Candidate Elliot Reyes — final comp proposal and ask

Sean — I pulled recent precedents and conferred with People Ops. Summary:

- One-time equity refreshes in the 0.5%–0.8% range have been approved twice in the last 12 months for hires at this level when there was immediate, measurable product impact. Both included a 12-month clawback clause and 4-year vesting for the refresh tranche.
- Sign-on amounts ranged from $15k–$40k for similar hires; $35k is within precedent but leans toward the high side.
- We should require a recruiting justification memo that documents competing offer specifics and a short impact statement from Marissa. This reduces audit friction.

Recommend: approve subject to (a) 12-month clawback in offer letter, (b) written justification memo attached to the candidate file, and (c) HR review of reporting/comp-grade assignment to ensure no band creep. If you approve these conditions, People Ops will process as an exception without full Comp Committee review.

I approve the exception under the conditions above. Laura
Director, People Ops
Redwood Inference

Elliot — excited to send a final offer. Key points included below; full packet attached via the secure link.

- Title: Senior Staff Engineer, Inference Core
- Base: $220,000 (top of band)
- Equity: standard grant + one-time 0.75% refresh, 4-year vesting schedule (refresh fully vests over 4 years), subject to 12-month clawback if departure before 12 months
- Sign-on: $35,000 (paid in two installments: 60% at start, 40% at 12 months subject to clawback)
- Start date: flexible in May/June; target June 10 if acceptable

We appreciate you taking time to evaluate Redwood. Please review and let us know if you'd like to accept — we requested a confirmation by EOD 4/25 to align with the other timeline. Offer packet (signed) will include the standard change-of-control language and a short performance milestone plan for first 90 days.

Attachments: offer packet (link), comp-band-reference.pdf

Best,
Marissa
